note: Codes: data/mexico_2025_safety.do (Bookmark #33, Q4 2024 Government Performance) keeps INEGI columns bp3_1_01..bp3_1_16, bp3_1_99, bp3_2, bp3_2a, bp3_3, bp3_4, bp3_5, bp3_6 from conjunto_de_datos_ensu_cb_1224.csv (import delimited case(lower)) and reshapes long with item = column name (core model s3 pattern 1, no positional step); the bookmark is identical to Q2's #24 apart from input dataset and output name (diffed), and differs from Q3's #28 only by adding bp3_3-bp3_6. mapping_basis=data_labels: INEGI's Q4 data dictionary labels each BP3_* column (e.g. BP3_1_02 'Problemas que enfrenta la ciudad: Deficiencias en la red publica de drenaje'; BP3_1_16 '...: Ninguno'; BP3_2 'Efectividad del gobierno de su ciudad para resolver problemas'; BP3_3 'Realizacion de tramite, pago o solicitud de forma directa ante un(a) servidor(a) publico(a) o empleado(a) de gobierno'; BP3_5 'Contacto directo con autoridades de seguridad publica (transito, municipales, estatales u otras)'; BP3_6 'Practica de corrupcion experimentada: ... por parte de policias de transito, municipales, estatales u otras autoridades de seguridad publica'); 23/23 agree in content with the Q4 questionnaire item carrying the same code number (3.1 options 01-16, 99; 3.2; 3.2a; 3.3-3.6). Q4 vs Q3/Q2 (checked, not assumed): Q4 is the Q2 shape -- the Q4 print carries CP3 and 3.3-3.6 on p.5 before Seccion IV. Acoso, and the Q4 dictionary, raw CSV and .do bookmark all carry bp3_3-bp3_6. A normalised pdftotext diff of Q2 vs Q4 pp.4-5 differs only in layout order, page-break position and the footer (Cuarto trimestre ... 2025), plus one wording change: option 12 is printed 'fraudes, etcetera)' in Q4 (as in Q1/Q3), not Q2's 'etcetera.)' -- the Q4 text layer reads 'etcetera).. 12' and a 200-dpi render of p.4 shows the two dots are the leader after the parenthesis; shipped as printed. The Q4 dictionary label for BP3_1_12 also now reads 'etcetera)' (Q3's said 'etc.)'). All 31 distinct printed Spanish strings shipped (3.1 stem, 17 options, 3.2-3.6 stems, CP3, printed options) are found in the Q4 text layer (pp.4-5) after whitespace/dot-leader normalisation; nothing rests on a render alone. Cross-check (route 9 style): all 23 live item vectors reproduce the raw INEGI Q4 2024 CSV after the .do's recodes, 48/48 item x level counts (e.g. bp3_1_01 0/1 = 8770/14681, bp3_1_16 0/1 = 23015/436, bp3_1_99 0/1 = 23433/18, bp3_2 1/2/3/4 = 897/6630/9808/5521, bp3_2a 1/2 = 7403/15236, bp3_3 1/2 = 6847/16592, bp3_4 1/2 = 679/6167, bp3_5 1/2 = 3124/20315, bp3_6 1/2 = 1433/1691); raw 23451 rows = 23451 live ids, 501010 live rows. Code 9 set missing by the .do: bp3_2 141, bp3_2a 812, bp3_3 12, bp3_4 1, bp3_5 12, bp3_6 0. Routing (not a defect): bp3_2 blank in raw for 454 = 436 (bp3_1_16 Ninguno) + 18 (bp3_1_99), matching 'SI SE REGISTRO CODIGO 16 ... O 99 ..., PASE A 3.2a'; bp3_4 non-blank for exactly the 6847 bp3_3=Si (blank 16604 = 16592 No + 12 NS, 'PASE A 3.5'); bp3_6 non-blank for exactly the 3124 bp3_5=Si (blank 20327 = 20315 No + 12 NS, 'PASE A CP4'). Words: item_text / section_prompt are the administered Q4 questionnaire wording (text_source=study_materials). Kept as printed: '(CIUDAD)' fill, '(a)' gender fills, 'etcetera)' in 12. Normalised: double space in 06 'limpia y  recoleccion' (visible in the Q4 render too) collapsed; line wraps joined with a space. Stripped: question numbers, option codes, dot leaders, 'ESPECIFIQUE' blank after Otro, interviewer directions (MUESTRE LA TARJETA 'C'; CIRCULE LOS CODIGOS CORRESPONDIENTES / UN SOLO CODIGO; skip instructions PASE A 3.2a / 3.5 / CP4). Tarjeta C is not in the questionnaire zip and was not transcribed. Structure (same as batch_677): section _1 = 3.1 (stem in section_prompt, option wording in item_text), _2 = 3.2, _3 = 3.2a, _4 = 3.3+3.4 (CP3 read-aloud definition of 'persona servidora publica' in section_prompt), _5 = 3.5, _6 = 3.6; instructions blank -- Section III has no whole-section introduction. Options: bp3_1_* are 0/1 flags for a circled code; option_text is INEGI's catalogo label ('0' = 'No se declaro como opcion afirmativa', '1' = 'Si', identical in all 17 Q4 catalogos), not questionnaire print. bp3_2 1-4 = Muy/Algo/Poco/Nada efectivo; bp3_2a, bp3_3-bp3_6 1/2 = Si/No -- printed and identical in the Q4 catalogos; code 9 'No sabe / no responde' has no row (set missing by the .do). Every level each item's respondents used has an option row (48/48 live item x resp cells). Step 3b: live items match this question block exactly (23 = 17 + 1 + 1 + 4); dictionary Description ('Resident evaluations of local and federal government security performance, Q4 2024') overstates it -- nothing asks about the federal government; the dictionary Reference names 'ENSU 2023' while data and wording are the 2024 Q4 (diciembre 2024, file suffix 1224) wave -- same defect as the siblings. INEGI-side cosmetic label defects, no effect on shipped text: BP3_1_09 label has a double space after the colon, BP3_4 label ends '...de algun beneficio ' (trailing space, and unlike BP3_6 it never names who), Q4 dictionary PER range reads '0424'. English in _translated is this project's own translation (machine_translation), reused verbatim from batch_677 (Q2) for every field -- the Spanish is identical string for string except option 12's period, and batch_677's option-12 English was itself carried unchanged from batch_673 (Q1 'etcetera)'); nothing translated fresh. INEGI publishes no English questionnaire.
public_note: Fuente: INEGI, Encuesta Nacional de Seguridad Pública Urbana (ENSU) 2024, cuarto trimestre -- IRW transcribed Section III (questions 3.1-3.6) from INEGI's questionnaire, stripped interviewer directions, used INEGI's data-catalogue labels for the 0/1 checklist codes, and added an English translation of its own; INEGI does not endorse this item text.
